study.question: Does exact target-advertisement equality at historical event positions recover the full-ID click-AUC advantage when learned historical ID embedding values are removed, and do those learned values add utility conditional on the retained exact-match pathways?
study.hypothesis: Observed: g3-r0078-history_id_full_reproduction exactly reproduces the imported fixed-seed click AUC 0.6689612705559688; g3-r0078-history_id_blind gives 0.668209129534341 (full minus blind 0.0007521410216278); g3-r0078-history_id_counts_only gives 0.6681676591189352 (0.0000414704154058 below blind). All have 32192421 parameters. The reproduced full run is a deterministic same-seed bridge, not an independent repetition. Full improves the 1-16 and 17-64 history slices versus blind but slightly worsens the >64 slice; no uniform history-length benefit is established. Full also has lower auxiliary AUCs than blind. Counts-only is a scientifically negative replacement despite successful execution. Mechanism hypothesis: much of the full-ID advantage may arise from exact target-ID equality entering aligned match counts, affinity/detail coefficients and training support membership, rather than learned historical identity values. The previous full/blind/counts contrasts jointly changed these pathways and did not isolate them. One hybrid keeps the complete incumbent equality pathway while zeroing only historical item_id embedding values. Equality can select the other aligned historical fields/actions without retaining an embedding for the historical advertisement. Recovery would support conditional utility of this composite equality pathway; it would not establish a behavioral cause or distinguish its individual count/gating/order components.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived exact-version DIN primary text, arXiv1706.06978v4, lines220-279: group-wise embeddings and target-conditioned unnormalized activation pooling. The local baseline is an adaptation, not an exact reproduction. This proposal introduces no new attention architecture; it intervenes on two ID-access pathways in the imported successful model. No novelty claim.

Only the pinned author README was accessible/read; it explicitly says that its behavior dataset has category, brand and behavior type but no item. Publisher full paper remains unverified. It cannot establish transfer or priority for these real historical advertisement IDs, which are not shopping-event IDs.

Cached primary benchmark section2.3 lines15,27,33 inspected for TokenMixer, HyFormer and EST descriptions. These describe representation mixing or cross-attention, not a conditional historical-ID ablation. Original method papers/code not audited here; changing those architectures would introduce additional factors.

Closest local implementation and matched control, SHA256 ef231472aca84aeadd095e12b3b3c4840ea86cd7a5ae6f4dd77c1f97a0be05ce. Inspecting _represent and _target_match_summary shows learned ID values and exact-ID membership/count/affinity/support paths. New source changes only the former; every match-derived path is retained verbatim.

inherited_components: Standalone full source/config from g3-r0065-fixed_angle_cycle_source_bit_negative; existing g3-r0078-history_id_full_reproduction is the byte-identical measured reproduction.
Shared field embeddings including current-target ID; action-aware local activation; temporal compression; five detail summaries; task residual banks and context-history product modules.
Frozen historical task masks and matching exclusions for padding/OOV; true-label four-task loss; incumbent first-order surrogate context VJP and all private gradients.
No new modules, learnable parameters, buffers, RNG, external input, loss change or training-recipe change.
study.proposed_difference: In Model._represent only, replace item_emb[item_id][:,:-1] by torch.zeros_like of that slice, concatenate the original final target embedding, and leave raw item IDs untouched. Consequently all exact target-ID matches, counts, match unions, detail coefficients and training support follow the full model. The ID-blind existing control instead suppresses these equality paths as well. This hybrid is not identity-blind and is not a counts-only model.
predictions: If equality pathways account for most of the observed advantage, exact-match-only exceeds g3-r0078-history_id_blind and approaches g3-r0078-history_id_full_reproduction in full-population click AUC. Predeclared descriptive near-recovery criterion: absolute AUC gap to full <=0.00015 with positive delta to blind. This tolerance is a practical diagnostic, not a significance/equivalence test.

Report raw full-minus-hybrid and hybrid-minus-blind AUC/Logloss deltas regardless of threshold. Intermediate performance suggests both pathways or their interaction matter; hybrid worse than blind suggests a harmful equality-only implementation or optimization interaction.

Expected unchanged 32192421 parameters (31793216 embedding,399205 dense). Current-target embeddings and non-ID tensors are identical at fixed parameters. Zero historical learned values change sparse gradient exposure intentionally. Inference/training cost must be measured, not inferred from size.
No guaranteed direction is predicted for auxiliary tasks or individual history-length slices. Report their tradeoffs separately; click AUC remains the sole selection metric.
falsifiers: A hybrid result near blind or worse, with the full-minus-hybrid gap retained, falsifies near-sufficiency of this equality-only implementation under the frozen recipe. It does not refute all recurrence mechanisms.

Hybrid recovery to within the descriptive tolerance of full weakens the claim that learned historical ID values are necessary conditional on this exact-match implementation; a tiny raw difference is not evidence of statistical equivalence.

Parameter/module/config mismatch, altered target-ID embeddings, changed masks/other fields, nonfinite outputs/gradients, or unauthorized exposure invalidate a claimed controlled contrast. Preserve any failed host receipt and charged cost.
A prohibitive measured cost penalty removes an efficiency claim even if the hybrid improves AUC. No test result is used to change the design.
alternative_explanations: One fixed seed and one training pass cannot establish repeated support; deterministic reproduction supplies no independent initialization evidence. Three paired seeds do not fit this remaining budget.

Zeroing a value coordinate changes effective functional capacity and shared embedding gradient exposure although nominal parameter count, initialization and data exposure are matched. Results concern pathway access under this implementation, not information-theoretic necessity.

Exact-match retention affects counts, affinity, match union, detail coefficients and training Dice support jointly. These are a composite equality pathway; this study cannot attribute gains to one part or establish event-order causation.

Counts-only retains a finite-width mean embedding and target count. Its failure may be lossy compression, changed scaling or optimization, not proof that unordered historical identity information is intrinsically useless.
The complementary embedding-only cell is omitted to preserve budget; full two-factor interaction is not identifiable. No independent permutation or order control is implemented.

History-mask memberships and remaining fields can proxy identity. Whole-window vocabularies/static snapshots and official_offline delayed-feedback visibility limit production point-in-time conclusions.
The inherited context backward is a surrogate VJP rather than the ordinary derivative of the stated joint BCE. Its dependence on changed forward values is retained in every contrast.
Wall time varies across sessions; nominal model size alone cannot establish equal compute. Current-target ID table retention means this ablation cannot claim model storage savings.
